lens: Geometry and proportion first. Scripts are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/34470b21-5ad4-5cec-977a-20c7657c0e01/scratchpad/raterB38/. m.py is the w37 patch script re-pointed to r37 vs r38. pans.py measures per-seat pan and pillow boxes on q15 (pans: render y 535-572, photo 525-570; pillows: render 430-465, photo 420-460). far.py takes the far-row stats on seat pixels only (B-R > 22), with the photo boxes moved up 35 px to the same rows, which removes the framing gap. Crops in the same folder: z_low.png and z_far.png (y_47300 | r37 | r38), t_q15/q16/q17 (photo | r37 | r38 triptychs), c_A.png (e10 + e4b, s37 | s38), c_B.png (e7 + e11), c_C.png (e1 + e3) and pouch38.png. The r37 to r38 diff changes 28.5 % of q15, 13.4 % of q16 and 18.0 % of q17 pixels. Much of that comes from the lighting edit in 9624e60, which is in r38 but not r37. The unchanged lattice pan (ECON_PAN_B) dropped from L79.2 to 68.1, so near pans read about 10 L darker from lighting alone. In the studio, e7 changes 38.9 %, e4b 22.5 %, e11 21.4 %, e1 19.5 % and e10 16.5 %; the others are under 5 %.

priorIssues.status: partly fixed / largely a measurement artefact
priorIssues.note: The fixed far box (300-640, 150-200) reads L131.8 B/R 1.30 vs r37 133.5 / 1.31 and photo 112.3 / 1.48, but on seat pixels only it reads L94.8 B/R 1.72 vs photo 93.4 / 1.72. Seat pixels fill only 64 % of that box in the render vs 84 % in the photo, so most of the old 21 L gap came from the end wall and curtains in frame. Row-matched boxes: farA (photo shifted 35 px up) reads L92.8 B/R 1.71 vs 97.1 / 1.70; farB reads 85.2 / 1.72 vs 85.9 / 1.76. Colour and level now match to within 4 L. What remains is contrast: p90/p10 2.54-2.64 vs 3.20-3.72. Light pixels (L>150) are 5.0 % vs 13.6 % in farA, because the photo has bright headrest-top highlights and dark screens/gaps that we lack. That is less sparkle than the photo, not snow. The far-LOD retint itself moved the far rows only about 1.5 L.

Pan B/R per seat: tick 1.86 and 1.85 (r37 1.98 / 1.96; photo 1.74 / 1.81), dash 1.88 (2.07; photo 1.74). The lattice pan, whose material is unchanged, went 1.87 -> 1.97 (photo 1.84) through lighting. Pan L is now 64-69 vs photo 74-87, about 10 L dark, and that is the lighting edit (the unchanged lattice moved the same amount). Contrast p90/p10 rose to 3.88 / 4.27 / 2.77 (photo 4.93 / 4.54 / 2.97).

priorIssues.id: w37b-3 (low) pouch dark / opaque / short strap
priorIssues.status: partly fixed; new issue in high views
priorIssues.note: e10: the shell now reads (82-90) grey and the strap hangs about 4 cm below the rim, close to the p302crop look. It is still opaque, with no vest, leg or rail visible through it. Tipping to 50 deg turned the disc face away from the high front cameras: in e7 and e1 the pouch is now a 2-3 px light sliver with a red strap that appears to float, where y_47302 (taken from above and in front) shows the fan face. See w38b-2.

priorIssues.id: w37b-4 (low) pillows plaques; belts V + buckle blocks
priorIssues.note: The belt V is shorter: teal strap pixels under the q15 pillows fell from 60 to 2. The grey and silver buckle blocks are unchanged in area (light-grey px in 4 x 100 x 65 windows: 984 -> 997) and now sit as two light blocks at the pillow foot on every pan. y_47300 shows none. The pillow is now the right hue (B/R 2.05-2.06 vs photo 1.99-2.03, r37 1.85-1.88) but darker than the photo: L38-40 vs 47-62. The pillow/pan ratio is 0.58 vs photo 0.66 (r37 0.79). The shape is still a plain rounded plaque.

issues.title: Grey and silver buckle blocks still on every q15 pan at the pillow foot
issues.evidence: Light-grey px in the 4 pan windows: 997 (r37 984), about 250 px per seat. y_47300 shows no belt hardware; it is tucked away.
issues.fix: In econSeat's belt loop (09a_econ.js ~283), give buckle and cover a lower y (0.478 -> 0.465) and z -0.20 -> -0.17 so they sit under the pillow's front edge. Or darken both to the strap navy for this view: SEATMAT.buckle stays only on s<0 with c '#4a4e58', cover '#3a3f52'. Cheapest: cover '#5d6168' -> '#3a3f52' and tongue to { ...SEATMAT.buckle, c: '#6a6e76' }.

issues.title: Life-vest pouch tipped the wrong way: edge-on sliver from the high front views
issues.evidence: With rx = 90-50 = 40 deg and phi 0..pi, the face normal is (0, .77, +.64), pointing up and aft, so the e7/e1 cameras (about 35 deg above, in front) see it edge-on. The result is a 2-3 px light line and a strap hanging from nothing. y_47302 shows the fan face from above and in front, with the curved edge leading forward and down. The shell is also opaque.
issues.fix: In 09a_econ.js:185-186 use rx = -(Math.PI/2 - 50*DEG) with phi0 = Math.PI (the half toward -z). The face normal is then (0, .77, -.64), pointing up and forward, and the curved edge leads forward and down. Move the strap and tag to the straight top edge (z -0.36 + 0.01). Optional: shell transparency or core '#5e6068' -> '#55585f'. Check e10, e7 and e1 against p302crop.

issues.title: Pillow now slightly dark; still a plain plaque
issues.evidence: Pillow L38-40 vs y_47300 47-62. The pillow/pan ratio is 0.58 vs 0.66. Hue matches (B/R 2.05 vs 2.0).
issues.fix: SEATMAT.yPillow '#30364d' -> '#363d57' (shared, one line). The shape stays as w37b-4: loft with the corners pulled out 1.5 cm and the mid-edges pinched 1 cm.

issues.title: Far rows: right colour, too little contrast (no dark gaps, no headrest-top highlights)
issues.evidence: Row-matched seat pixels: p90/p10 2.54-2.64 vs 3.20-3.72. L>150 is 5.0 % vs 13.6 % (farA).
issues.fix: In econUnitFar, add a 1 cm dark '#1c2236' strip under each headrest cover and on the seat-back top behind it (row gap), and raise ECON_HEAD_L far tint toward '#5a6898' so the headrest tops catch light. Do not move the LOD switch.
